The measurement belongs to the open context and its access rights. Drawing creates neither an official parcel nor a right of way.
Each map tap adds a vertex. Distance joins points in order; area closes the boundary without adding a vertex. Phone GPS is not required.
Units only change the display: 1 km = 1,000 m, 1 are = 100 m², 1 ha = 10,000 m². Full values and points are retained. Decimal places do not guarantee accuracy.

The name is optional and is never used as a file path. Saving retains an immutable measurement in the local database, with its method and context. It does not mean synchronization, remote backup, or retention after uninstalling.
